## About

Jacques Azianou is a Nigerian full-stack developer and UI/UX designer specializing in React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, and modern frontend architecture. His work focuses on performance, accessibility, animation, and thoughtful user experiences.
